title: CI run recovery recipes
text: When a QA case attaches to a CI run it names the run, then teaches only registered commands: `yoke github-actions failed-log` for each failed job and `yoke github-actions run cancel` to cancel. The failed-log report prefers pytest FAILURES / ERRORS and Vitest Failed Tests / Failed Suites sections over trailing error annotations; bounded test regions keep their first failure and summary. It prints no `gh` watch or force-cancel recipe; the running `yoke qa case run` invocation is the watch. The gate itself force-cancels a run that never starts and redispatches it, and a stalled-dispatch detail and the cancel refusal say so. Observed in source and tests; deployed proof is pending.
